item.case_name: Add a logo or text overlay
item.title: Fox Logo Throughout the Clip

turns.text: Put this fox in the top-right corner as a small logo for the whole video. Remove its white background, leave a little space around it, and keep the video and sound otherwise unchanged.

item.tests: Tests persistent corner-logo compositing, clean background removal, and preservation of the source video and audio.

answer_sheet.Logo asset and treatment: Use mascot-fox.png, removing the white background without removing parts of the fox.
answer_sheet.Logo position, size, and timing: Top-right corner with a small inset, visible throughout all 10 seconds; small enough not to cover the woman's face.
answer_sheet.Video framing and sound: Keep the source aspect ratio, framing, timing, and original speech. No new music or text.

must_haves: The video shows the same woman at the kitchen table, with the source framing and sequence preserved.
The supplied orange-hoodie fox appears in the top-right corner from the first frame through the last frame.
The fox has no visible white rectangular background and is not clipped at the frame edges.
The logo remains small and does not obscure the woman's face.
The original speech remains audible and synchronized throughout the 10-second clip.

turns.text: Could you add the fox from this pic to the clip as a small logo? I like this fox and thought it would be a nice little finishing touch. What I mean is, it should sit in the top-right corner and stay there for the whole video. Please remove the white background from the fox pic and leave a little space around the logo. Other than adding that, keep the video and sound unchanged.

dialog.agent:
Got it: the fox with its white background removed, small and fixed in the top-right corner with a little padding, throughout the entire clip—everything else, including sound, unchanged.

I can’t complete that precise overlay with the connected tools. They support AI video edits, but not a fixed image overlay that preserves the original footage and audio. I wouldn’t use an AI edit here because it could change the video.

In a standard video editor, add the fox as an image overlay, remove its white background, resize and position it with top/right padding, then extend it for the full clip. Leave the original audio track untouched. No generation credits have been spent.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
I tried removing the fox’s white background, but Magic Hour refused the request because the account has insufficient credits. Nothing was generated, and your video and sound are unchanged.

To finish without Magic Hour credits, use a video editor with background removal: add the fox as an overlay, remove the white, make it small, position it top-right with padding, and extend it across the full clip. Keep the original audio track untouched.
